title: Lockout-tagout safety procedure before servicing electrical enclosure
context: Standard electrical safety protocols require a strict lockout-tagout (LOTO) procedure prior to accessing high-voltage service panels. An autonomous robot must verify de-energization in strict sequence: switch off the main circuit breaker, physically lock the breaker off by inserting a dedicated lockout pin, verify zero voltage by pressing a test button to confirm the dead indicator lamp, and only then open a spring-return service cover to press the internal service button. Violating the sequence exposes the robot and surrounding equipment to live electrical hazard and constitutes an immediate safety fault.
instruction: Switch the breaker off, lock it with the red pin, press TEST, then hold the cover open and press the blue service button: never open the cover while the breaker is on.
setup: All positions are cm from the midpoint between arm bases (x forward, y left); table top is z = 0. Console: 24.0 x 54.0 x 2.0 cm base plate at (30.0, +6.0). Main breaker on left at y = +18.0 cm with 4.0 cm throw slider (starts ON at x = 28.0 cm, pushed OFF to x = 32.0 cm) and a 28 mm square lockout pin hole through the plate. Red lockout pin (1.6 cm diameter x 5.0 cm tall) starts on stand at (22.0, +28.0 cm). TEST pushbutton (4.0 x 4.0 x 1.2 cm) at (30.0, +3.5 cm) with 3.0 cm diameter LIVE (amber) and DEAD (green) indicator lamps at x = 36.0 cm. Service enclosure on right at y = -4.0 cm with a 12.0 x 8.0 x 1.5 cm spring-return sliding cover (18 N/m, 9.0 cm travel toward robot) with a 2.0 x 4.5 x 3.0 cm handle on its front edge, concealing a 4.0 x 4.0 x 1.2 cm blue service button.
scoring: Score: 0.25 when the breaker is switched OFF (LIVE lamp off); 0.50 when the red lock pin is seated in the breaker hole; 0.75 when TEST is pressed and verified DEAD (green lamp shown); 1.00 when the blue SERVICE button is pressed while the cover is held open >= 7.0 cm for >= 1.0 s, pin still seated, with no FAULT, and holds for 20 control steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz). Zero-gates: opening the service cover >= 2.0 cm before the breaker is OFF, before the pin is seated, or before TEST verified DEAD triggers a safety FAULT, latching score permanently to 0.0.
reset_notes: Verify breaker slider is in the ON position (x = 28.0 cm) and LIVE lamp is lit. Confirm red lock pin rests on its stand at (22.0, +28.0 cm). Confirm service cover is fully closed (< 0.5 cm) and DEAD lamp is unlit.
fidelity: Console is a rigid fixture plate. Breaker lever, test button, service cover, and service button are modeled as physical prismatic sliders with spring rates, limit stops, and damping. Red lock pin is a physical rigid cylinder. Indicator lamps are updated dynamically via write_pose. Real-world build: industrial electrical safety console with interlocked disconnect switch, physical hasp/pin, test push-to-test meter, and spring-return maintenance hatch.
